keys: rows are keyed by MOVE SLOT (hex), not by bank row: reaction records, throw-victim entries and air kinds name slots. rec.move_row = bank row, or 0x40000000 + divmot99 row (rec.src).
bones_note: WH-Canonical-22 names; joints the source rig lacks are identity. Local rotations are relative to the parents in skeleton.json (the 18-part T3 rigs hang Chest off Root), as for the shipped wh-anim/1 bank clips.
anchor_note: ax/ay/az: decoded root channels 0-2, mm, move heading frame (+Z forward, +Y up, +X = the bake's Left side); rx/ry/rz: hips delta from frame 0 in the yaw-normalised frame, rig metres x1000 (same as rows.pack.json). yaw0: frame-0 Hips yaw (rad) in the heading frame.
